# TeaMax Café

TeaMax is an India-focused café brand serving tea, coffee, fresh juices, shakes, ice creams and café favourites, with a franchise opportunity for entrepreneurs.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://www.teamaxcafe.in/
- Our Story: https://www.teamaxcafe.in/about-us
- Menu: https://www.teamaxcafe.in/menu
- Franchise: https://www.teamaxcafe.in/franchise
- Stores / Gallery: https://www.teamaxcafe.in/stores
- Stories / Blog: https://www.teamaxcafe.in/blog

Use the linked pages as the primary source for current TeaMax information. Investment, outlet counts, locations, menu availability and franchise terms can change and should be verified from the current website before being presented as current facts.
